message.content:
Multi-phase AC motor, output 42.5 kW, which is above 37.5 W, so it falls under 8501.5x. The relevant range is 750 W to 75 kW, which is 8501.52.

HTSUS 8501.52: "Other AC motors, multi-phase: of an output exceeding 750 W but not exceeding 75 kW."
- 8501.52.20: Of an output exceeding 746 W but not exceeding 14.92 kW
- 8501.52.40: Exceeding 14.92 kW but not exceeding 75 kW... Under the current schedule, 8501.52.40 is "Exceeding 14.92 kW but not exceeding 75 kW," with the 10-digit level being 8501.52.4000 (the 8-digit has no further breakdown). Older versions listed 8501.52.40 as 8501.52.4000 and 8501.52.60 as another range. Current: 8501.52.20 (750 W to 14.92 kW), 8501.52.40 (14.92 kW to 75 kW). The 8501.52.20 line has statistical suffixes 8501.52.2000 for the 10-digit level, and I believe 8501.52.4000 is the equivalent for 8501.52.40.

Motors for submersible pumps are not pump parts, since they are imported separately, so they stay in 8501.

{"hts_code": "8501.52.4000", "reason": "A multi-phase AC motor with an output of 42.5 kW, imported separately from the pump, is classified in 8501.52 for outputs exceeding 750 W but not exceeding 75 kW, and in subheading 8501.52.40 because it exceeds 14.92 kW."}
